findings.failure_mode: The self-test's own gate is fail-OPEN on NaN: assertClose computes rel = NaN for a non-finite `got` and `NaN > relTol` is false, so a broken radialProfile/geometryAreaM2 returning NaN prints 'ok' and passes the entire self-test (opus#1).

The R7 cross-coverage `mismatch` guard cannot fire for a real ENCLOSING ring (a ray from an interior origin always crosses a closed boundary); a missing wedge on an enclosing ring casts a SHORT ray caught by the worst-sector max, not a null — the comment and docs over-credit the guard (opus#2).
findings.fix_evidence: NOT for a missing wedge on an enclosing ring

findings.failure_mode: The manifest says a public-vs-public run 'cannot report parity' and contradicts itself two lines later with the honest limit; provenance must rest on configuration, not output (opus#3, sol#1).
findings.fix_evidence: A fully airtight output-side proof needs request-level

findings.failure_mode: A network HEAD under `set -e` runs BEFORE the cached-file check, so an outage or retired URL blocks a valid md5-verified cached rebuild (sol#3).
